title: Hinowa ga CRUSH!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: On the island of Wakoku, a civil war among many states lets anyone rise as a hero. Years after the soldier Hinowa is killed by the commander Yomihime, her daughter takes her name and joins a band of soldiers seeking revenge and recognition. Akame, from the earlier series Akame ga Kill!, washes ashore and joins the story.
life_message: Strength, comradeship and courage let ordinary people win a place and protect those they love in a brutal world.
